_readme: device_match: substring of the evdev device name (see --list).
axes: evdev ABS code -> target one of lx, ly, rx, ry, lt, rt.
invert flips the axis, deadzone is 0..1, expo 0..1 softens the centre.
buttons: per mode layer. Key = evdev code name from --probe.
Targets: a b x y lb rb view menu ls rs dpad_up dpad_down dpad_left dpad_right
or select_mode1 / select_mode2 / select_mode3 for the X52 mode switch.
select_mode entries only need to appear under mode1; they work globally.
Run --probe, press each control, and put the printed names in here.
